name: Nike Dunk Low Premium SB QS 'De La Soul'
story_html: The Nike SB Dunk Low 'De La Soul' is a low-top remix of the 2005 high-top colorway designed in collaboration with alt-rap trio De La Soul. The design features a Baroque Brown suede upper with Altitude Green elephant print and vinyl graphic overlays inspired by the cover of their debut album 3 Feet High and Rising. Released in May 2015, the sneaker also comes with a green midsole and brown outsole.
